children.name: text
children: {TheSupplier} (Company Number {SubContractorReg}), whose registered office is at {RegisteredAddress}, ("the Consultant")

children.name: text
children: {b:THIS DEED IS MADE THE               DAY OF                                 202X]}

children.name: text
children: {b:[TheSupplier]}  incorporated and registered in England and Wales with company number {SubContractorReg} whose registered office is {RegisteredAddress} (the "{b:Consultant}").

children.name: text
children: {ProjectClientName} ("the {b:Client}") intends to employ the Contractor to carry out and complete the Project under the Building Contract.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor wishes to appoint the Consultant on the terms of this agreement.

children.name: text
children: The definitions and rules of interpretation in this clause apply in this agreement.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Additional Fee"} means the amount payable by the Contractor to the Consultant for the Additional Services under this agreement.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Additional Services"} means the services set out in Part 2 of Schedule 1 or otherwise agreed in writing by the Contractor and Consultant and any services required under a Third Party Agreement notified by the Contractor to the Consultant after the date of this agreement.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Basic Fee"} means the amount payable by the Contractor to the Consultant for the Basic Services under this agreement.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Base Rate"} means the rate set from time to time by the Bank of England's Monetary Policy Committee or any successor to it.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Basic Services"} means the services set out in Part 1 of Schedule 1 and any services required under a Third Party Agreement, where a copy or relevant extract is attached at Schedule 5.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Building Contract"} means a contract to be entered into between the Client and the Contractor for the Project

children.name: text
children: {b:"Business Day"} means a day (other than a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in England) when banks in London are open for business.

children.name: text
children: {b:"CDM Regulations"} means the Construction (Design and Management) Regulations 2015 and the related Guidance on Regulations (L153) issued by the Health and Safety Executive.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Client's Brief"} means the brief for the Project provided to the Consultant by the Contractor [and attached to this agreement at Schedule [6]], including any modification, amendment or variation thereto as advised by the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Contractor's Representative"} means the person identified in Part 2 of Schedule 3, who may be replaced from time to time under clause 0.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Consultant's Representative"} means the person identified in Part 3 of Schedule 3 who may be replaced from time to time under clause 0.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Deleterious"} means any materials building practices or techniques not in conformity with any relevant British and/or European Standards or Codes of Practice or which are generally known or which ought to have been known by the Consultant at the time of specification to be deleterious to health and safety or to the durability of buildings and/or other structures and/or finishes and/or plant and machinery in the particular circumstances in which they are used having regard to the British Council for Offices publication entitled "Good Practice in Selection of Construction Materials" dated 2011 and any other substance which is specifically prohibited under the terms of any Third Party Agreement.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Design Responsibility Matrix"} means the design responsibility matrix attached at Part 3 of Schedule 3 and any amendment or revisions to such Design Responsibility Matrix as is agreed between the parties (acting reasonably).

children.name: text
children: {b:"Fee"} means the Basic Fee and the Additional Fee (if any).

children.name: text
children: the Project or the completed Project; or

children.name: text
children: whether that person acts on its own account, as agent for a syndicate of other parties or otherwise].

children.name: text
children: {b:"Insolvent"} means a party is insolvent if:

children.name: text
children: it suspends, or threatens to suspend, payment of its debts or is unable to pay its debts as they fall due or admits inability to pay its debts or (being a company) is deemed unable to pay its debts within the meaning of section 123 of the Insolvency Act 1986 or (being a natural person) is deemed either unable to pay its debts or as having no reasonable prospect of so doing, in either case, within the meaning of section 268 of the Insolvency Act 1986 or (being a partnership) has any partner to whom any of the foregoing apply; or

children.name: text
children: it commences negotiations with all or any class of its creditors with a view to rescheduling any of its debts, or makes a proposal for or enters into any compromise or arrangement with its creditors; or

children.name: text
children: a petition is filed, a notice is given, a resolution is passed, or an order is made, for or on connection with its winding-up; or

children.name: text
children: an application is made to court, or an order is made, for the appointment of an administrator, or if a notice of intention to appoint an administrator is given or if an administrator is appointed over it; or

children.name: text
children: a floating charge holder over its assets has become entitled to appoint or has appointed, an administrative receiver; or

children.name: text
children: a person becomes entitled to appoint a receiver over its assets or a receiver is appointed over its assets; or

children.name: text
children: being an individual, it is the subject of a bankruptcy petition or order; or

children.name: text
children: a creditor or encumbrancer of it attaches or takes possession of, or a distress, execution, sequestration or other such process is levied or enforced on or sued against, the whole or any part of its assets and such attachment or process is not discharged within ten business days; or

children.name: text
children: any event occurs, or proceeding is taken, in any jurisdiction to which it is subject that has an effect equivalent or similar to any of the events mentioned in paragraphs (a) to (h) above (inclusive); or

children.name: text
children: it suspends or ceases, or threatens to suspend or cease, to carry on all or a substantial part of its business.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Key Personnel"} means the Consultant's personnel, identified in Part 1 of Schedule 3 who may be removed or replaced from time to time under clause 0.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Material"} means all designs, drawings, models, plans, specifications, design details, photographs, brochures, reports, notes of meetings, CAD materials, calculations, schedules, programmes, bills of quantities, budgets and any other materials provided in connection with the Project and all updates, amendments, additions and revisions to them and any works, designs, or inventions incorporated or referred to in them for any purpose relating to the Project.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Moral Rights"} means moral rights under Chapter IV Part 1 Copyright Designs and Patents Act 1988.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Permitted Uses"} means the design, construction, completion, reconstruction, modification, refurbishment, development, maintenance, funding, disposal, letting, fitting-out, advertisement, demolition, reinstatement, extension and repair of the Property and/or the Project.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Professional Team"} means the Consultant, the consultants listed in Schedule 6 and any other consultant notified by the Contractor to the Consultant

children.name: text
children: {b:"Programme"} means the programme agreed by the Consultant and the Contractor, setting out key dates and time periods for:

children.name: text
children: issuing Material and other documents; and

children.name: text
children: providing information relating to the Project,

children.name: text
children: as may be adjusted from time to time by agreement between the Client and the Consultant.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Project"} means the design and construction of {ProjectName}

children.name: text
children: {b:"Required Standard"} means the reasonable skill, standard and diligence to be expected of a qualified and experienced member of the Consultant's profession undertaking the Services on works similar in scope and character to the Project.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Scheme"} means the Scheme for Construction Contracts (England and Wales) Regulations 1998 as amended by the Scheme for Construction Contracts (England and Wales) Regulations 1998 (Amendment) (England) Regulations 2011(SI 2011/2333).

children.name: text
children: {b:"Services"} means the Basic Services and the Additional Services (if any).

children.name: text
children: {b:"Third Party Agreement"} means any agreement between the Client and a third party or the Contractor and a third party relating to the Project and of which:

children.name: text
children: a copy, or relevant extract, is attached at Schedule 5; or

children.name: text
children: the Contractor notifies the Consultant in writing after the date of this agreement but prior to performance of the relevant service enclosing a copy or relevant extracts.

children.name: text
children: {b:"VAT"} means value added tax imposed by the Value Added Tax Act 1994, or any similar tax in addition to or replacing it from time to time.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Warranty"} means a deed of warranty in the form at Schedule 4, or any other form that the Client proposes and the Consultant approves (such approval not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed).

children.name: text
children: Clause, Schedule and paragraph headings shall not affect the interpretation of this agreement.

children.name: text
children: A {b:person} includes a natural person, corporate or unincorporated body (whether or not having separate legal personality) and that person's legal and personal representatives, successors or permitted assigns.

children.name: text
children: The Schedules form part of this agreement and shall have effect as if set out in full in the body of this agreement. Any reference to this agreement includes the Schedules.

children.name: text
children: A reference to a {b:company} shall include any company, corporation or other body corporate, wherever and however incorporated or established.

children.name: text
children: Unless the context otherwise requires, words in the singular shall include the plural and, in the plural, include the singular.

children.name: text
children: Unless the context otherwise requires, a reference to one gender shall include a reference to the other genders.

children.name: text
children: A reference to a party shall include that party's legal and personal representatives, successors or permitted assigns.

children.name: text
children: A reference to a statute, statutory provision or subordinated legislation is a reference to it as it is in force from time to time, taking account of any amendment, extension, or re-enactment and includes any statute, statutory provision or subordinate legislation which it amends or re-enacts.

children.name: text
children: A reference to a statute or statutory provision shall include any subordinate legislation made from time to time under that statute or statutory provision.

children.name: text
children: Any reference to a party's {b:consent} or {b:approval} being required is to a consent or approval in writing, which must be obtained before the relevant action is taken or event occurs.

children.name: text
children: Any obligation in this agreement on a person not to do something includes an obligation not to agree or allow that thing to be done.

children.name: text
children: A reference to {b:writing} or {b:written} includes faxes, but not e-mail. A written document can, however, be issued as an attachment to an email.

children.name: text
children: References to clauses and schedules are to the clauses and schedules of this agreement; references to paragraphs are to paragraphs of the relevant schedule.

children.name: text
children: A reference to a document is a reference to that document as varied or novated (in each case, other than in breach of this agreement) at any time.

children.name: text
children: Unless this agreement expressly provides otherwise, a reference to the Property or the Project is to the whole and any part of it.

children.name: text
children: Unless expressly provided otherwise, the obligations and liabilities of the persons forming the parties under this agreement are joint and several.

children.name: text
children: Where the words {b:include(s)}, {b:including} or {b:in particular} are used in this agreement, they are deemed to have the words "without limitation" following them.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor appoints the Consultant to carry out the Services, subject to the terms of this agreement.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding the date of this agreement, this agreement shall have effect as if it had been executed upon the date the Consultant first performed any part of the Services and/or any other services in relation to the Project (whether under any previous agreement or understanding (written and/or oral) between the Consultant and the Client or otherwise) and accordingly the Consultant's duty and obligations to the Contractor set out in this agreement shall be deemed to apply to the carrying out of any such part of the Services and/or any other such services in relation to the Project undertaken prior to the date of this agreement and the Consultant acknowledges that the Contractor has placed reliance thereon.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant warrants and undertakes that it shall:

children.name: text
children: comply with the terms of this agreement;

children.name: text
children: carry out the Services in compliance with the Design Responsibility Matrix;

children.name: text
children: carry out and fulfil, in all respects, the duties of a designer under the CDM Regulations;

children.name: text
children: comply with (and ensure the Consultant's design complies with) any:

children.name: text
children: instrument, rule or order make under any Act of Parliament;

children.name: text
children: regulation or bye-law of any local authority, statutory undertaker or public or private utility or undertaking that has any jurisdiction over the Project or with whose systems or property the Project is or will be connected;

children.name: text
children: not specify or authorise for use any products or materials in the Project which are Deleterious at the time of specification;

children.name: text
children: not, without the Contractor's written consent, make any material change to the designs or specifications for the Project after they have been settled or approved;

children.name: text
children: perform its obligations under this agreement so as not to constitute, cause or contribute to any breach by the Client and/or the Contractor of any of their obligations referred to or contained in any Third Party Agreement;

children.name: text
children: provide the Contractor with as many copies of the final construction issue drawings of the Project as the Contractor reasonably requires in order to comply with its obligations under the Building Contract.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant warrants and undertakes that it shall exercise the Required Standard:

children.name: text
children: to perform the Services and prepare all Material for those elements of the Project for which the Consultant is responsible according to the Programme or, in the absence of a Programme, in sufficient time to facilitate the efficient progress of the Project; and

children.name: text
children: to see to it that the Consultant's design complies with all planning agreements, permissions, and conditions.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant's duties or liabilities under this agreement shall not be negated or diminished by:

children.name: text
children: any designs or specifications for the Property or the Project; or

children.name: text
children: any testing of any work, goods, materials, plant or equipment; or

children.name: text
children: any omission to approve, inspect or test,

children.name: text
children: by or on behalf of the Contractor provided that this clause does not prevent the Consultant from exercising its common law right of defence.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant shall maintain records of all time spent by its personnel in performing the Services.

children.name: text
children: Upon the Contractor’s written request, the Consultant shall allow the Contractor (or its representative) to inspect the records referred to in clause 0 and provide such copies as theContractor requests. The Contractor’s right to inspect and demand copies shall continue after theConsultant's engagement under this agreement has concluded or terminated.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding any other provision of this agreement, other than in an emergency or with the prior written consent of the Contractor, the Consultant has no authority to:

children.name: text
children: make (or instruct any member of the Professional Team to make) any material alteration to the Project or its Services;

children.name: text
children: vary, terminate or waive compliance with the terms of:

children.name: text
children: the appointment of any member of the Professional Team; or

children.name: text
children: enter into any contract, commitment or undertaking on behalf of the Contractor; or

children.name: text
children: without prejudice to clause 4.1, issue any instruction or notice under the Building Contract, the appointment of any member of the Professional Team or any Third Party Agreement that:

children.name: text
children: increases the cost of the Project.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor's Representative is the person identified in Part 2 of Schedule 3 or any replacement notified to the Consultant by the Client from time to time. The Contractor's Representative has full authority to act on the Contractor's behalf in connection with this agreement.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant's Representative is the person identified in Part 3 of Schedule 3 and has full authority to act on the Consultant's behalf in connection with this agreement.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant shall ensure that the Consultant's Representative and the Key Personnel:

children.name: text
children: devote sufficient time and attention fulfilling their respective roles;

children.name: text
children: are not removed without the Contractor's prior written consent (such consent not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed), except in the event of:

children.name: text
children: an illness making the relevant individual unavailable for work; or

children.name: text
children: the relevant individual leaving the Consultant's employment.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may at any time instruct the Consultant to remove any person engaged in performing the Services if, in the Contractor's reasonable opinion, that person's performance or conduct is unsatisfactory. The Consultant shall remove any such person promptly.

children.name: text
children: Any personnel appointed by the Consultant to replace staff removed under clause 0 or clause 0 shallbe subject to the written approval of the Contractor (such approval not to be unreasonably withheldor delayed).

children.name: text
children: the Basic Fee as full remuneration for the Basic Services; and

children.name: text
children: the Additional Fee as full remuneration for any Additional Services.

children.name: text
children: The Fee shall be the Consultant's entire remuneration under this agreement.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall reimburse the Consultant for any expenses or disbursements expressly identified in Schedule 1. Any other expenses and disbursements that the Consultant incurs are deemed to be included in the Fee. Any expenses or disbursements payable by the Contractor to the Consultant shall be included in the next invoice after they are incurred and paid by the Contractor in accordance with clause 0.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall pay the Consultant any VAT properly chargeable on the Services. Any amount expressed as payable to the Consultant under this agreement is exclusive of VAT unless stated otherwise.

children.name: text
children: The Fee shall be calculated and paid in instalments in accordance with Part 1 of XXX.

children.name: text
children: Schedule {b:2} If not set out in Part 1 of XXX

children.name: text
children: Schedule {b:2}, the Fee shall be paid at intervals of not less than one month, beginning one month after the Consultant begins performing the Services.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant shall submit to the Contractor an invoice for each instalment of Fee on the {DayMonthConsultantSubmitEnvoice} of each calendar month, together with any supporting documents that are reasonably necessary to check the invoice. The invoice and supporting documents (if any) shall specify the sum that the Consultant considers will become due on the payment due date in respect of the instalment of the Fee, and the basis on which that sum is calculated.

children.name: text
children: Payment shall be due on the date the Contractor receives each invoice.

children.name: text
children: No later than five days after payment becomes due, the Contractor shall notify the Consultant of the sum that the Contractor considers to have been due at the payment due date in respect of the payment and the basis on which that sum is calculated.

children.name: text
children: The final date for payment shall be 28 days after the date on which payment becomes due.

children.name: text
children: Subject to clause 0 and unless the Contractor has served a notice under clause 0, it shall pay theConsultant the sum referred to in the Contractor's notice under clause 0 (or, if the Contractor has notserved notice under clause 0, the sum referred to in the invoice referred to in clause 0) (in this clause0, the {b:"notified sum"}) on or before the final date for payment of each invoice.

children.name: text
children: Not less that two days before the final date for payment (in this clause 0, the {b:"prescribed period"}),the Contractor may give the Consultant notice that it intends to pay less than the notified sum (in thisclause 0, a {b:"pay less notice"}). Any pay less notice shall specify:

children.name: text
children: the sum that the payer considers to be due on the date the notice is served; an

children.name: text
children: the basis on which that sum is calculated

children.name: text
children: If the Contractor fails to pay an amount due to the Consultant by the final date for payment and failsto give a pay less notice under clause 0, simple interest shall be added to the unpaid amount from thefinal date for payment until the actual date of payment. This shall be calculated on a daily basis at theannual rate of 5% above the Base Rate. The parties acknowledge that the Contractor's liability underthis clause 0 is a substantial remedy for the purposes of section 9(1) of the Late Payment ofCommercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding clause 0 and clause 0 and without prejudice to clause 0, if the Consultant becomesinsolvent (which for the purposes of this clause 9.9 shall mean "insolven" as defined by section 113of the Housing Grants, Construction and Regeneration Act 1996, as amended) after the prescribedperiod, the Contractor shall not be required to pay the Consultant the notified sum on or before thefinal date for payment.

children.name: text
children: The Fee shall be adjusted if the performance of the Services is materially delayed or disrupted due to a change in the scope, size, complexity or duration of the Project, provided that the Consultant shall not be entitled to any adjustment of the Fee where delay or disruption arises from the Consultant's default or negligence, or the default or negligence of the Consultant's sub-contractors or suppliers (if any).

children.name: text
children: The Consultant shall notify the Contractor of its intention to claim an adjustment to the Fee as soon as reasonably practicable after it becomes aware of any material delay or disruption to the Services. The Consultant's notice shall include a written estimate of:

children.name: text
children: the proposed adjustment to the Fee; and

children.name: text
children: the likely effect of the delay or disruption on the Services and the Programme.

children.name: text
children: Unless the parties agree otherwise, the Fee shall be adjusted by a reasonable amount by reference to the time charges set out in Part 2 of XXX.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant shall notify the Contractor as soon as reasonably practicable if it becomes apparent that Additional Services are likely to be required, identifying the required services.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant shall perform an Additional Service on receipt of a written instruction to do so by the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: As soon as reasonably practicable after receiving an instruction to perform an Additional Service, the Consultant shall provide the Contractor with a written estimate of cost of the Additional Service and its effect on the Programme.

children.name: text
children: Unless the parties agree otherwise, the Additional Fee shall be a reasonable amount calculated by reference to the time charges set out in Part 2 of XXX

children.name: text
children: Schedule {b:2}, provided that no Additional Fee shall be payable if the requirement for an Additional Service arises from the Consultant's default or negligence, or the default or negligence of the Consultant's sub-contractors or suppliers (if any).

children.name: text
children: Any Additional Fee payable by the Contractor shall be included in the next invoice following performance of the Additional Service to which it relates.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may, at any time, suspend performance of all or part of the Services by giving written notice to the Consultant. Subject to clause 03, the Consultant shall resume performance of the Services as soon as reasonably practicable after receiving a written notice to do so from the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: subject to clause 0, the Contractor fails to pay in full the notified sum to the Consultant under this agreement by the final date for payment under clause 0; and

children.name: text
children: the Contractor has not given a pay less notice complying with clause 0,

children.name: text
children: the Consultant may suspend the performance of any or all of its Services and other obligations under this agreement by giving not less than seven days' notice to the Contractor of its intention to do so and stating the ground or grounds on which it intends to suspend performance.

children.name: text
children: In the event of a suspension in accordance with this agreement, the Contractor shall pay the Consultant:

children.name: text
children: a reasonable amount in respect of costs and expenses reasonably incurred by theConsultant as a result of any exercise of its right referred to in clause 0; and

children.name: text
children: (taking into account any sum paid under clause 0) any adjustment to the Fee due underclause 0,

children.name: text
children: and such payment shall be the Consultant's sole compensation for suspension of its Services and obligations under this agreement.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may terminate the Consultant's engagement under this agreement at any time by giving ten Business Days' notice in writing to the Consultant.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may immediately terminate the Consultant's engagement under this agreement by giving written notice to the Consultant if:

children.name: text
children: the Consultant is in material breach of its obligations under this agreement and fails to remedy that breach within ten Business Days of receiving written notice requiring it to do so; or

children.name: text
children: a suspension of the Services in accordance with clause 0 continues for a continuous periodof six months; and

children.name: text
children: the Contractor does not instruct the Consultant to resume the Services within ten Business Days of receiving a written notice from the Consultant requiring it to do so,

children.name: text
children: the Consultant may immediately terminate its engagement under this agreement by giving written notice to the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: On termination in accordance with clause 0 the Contractor shall pay the Consultant:

children.name: text
children: any amount properly due for payment under this agreement at the date of termination; and

children.name: text
children: a fair and reasonable proportion of the next instalment of the Fee commensurate with the Services properly performed at the date of termination.

children.name: text
children: If the Consultant's engagement under this agreement is terminated by the Contractor in accordance with clause 0 or clause 13.3 then the Contractor shall also pay any expenses and disbursements that the Consultant has reasonably and properly incurred as at the date of such termination in respect of which the Consultant would otherwise have been entitled to recover under the terms of this agreement.

children.name: text
children: Payment under clause 0 and clause 0 (if any) shall be:

children.name: text
children: the Consultant's sole entitlement to compensation for termination of its engagement under this agreement; and

children.name: text
children: claimed by the Consultant as if it was a payment under clause 0.

children.name: text
children: Except as set out in clause 0 and clause 0, the Contractor shall not be liable to the Consultant for:

children.name: text
children: any costs, expenses, disbursements or losses;

children.name: text
children: any loss of profits, loss of fees, loss of chance or other similar losses; or

children.name: text
children: any indirect losses or consequential losses

children.name: text
children: arising out of termination of the Consultant's engagement under this agreement.

children.name: text
children: Termination of the Consultant's engagement under this agreement shall not affect the accrued rights of either party under this agreement and the provisions of this agreement shall continue to bind the parties for as long as necessary to give effect to their respective rights and obligations.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may assign or otherwise transfer all or any of the benefit of this agreement without the consent of the Consultant:

children.name: text
children: by way of security (including any reassignment on redemption of security); and/or

children.name: text
children: to and from subsidiary or other associated companies within the same group of companies as the Client or the Contractor so long as that assignee company remains within the same group of companies as the Client or the Contractor; and/or

children.name: text
children: on two occasions to any other person,

children.name: text
children: PROVIDED THAT any further or other assignment shall be subject to the prior written consent of the Consultant which shall not be unreasonably withheld.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall notify the Consultant of any assignment. If the Contractor fails to do this, the assignment shall still be valid.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant shall not contend that any person to whom the benefit of this agreement is assigned under clause 0 may not recover any sum under this agreement because that person is an assignee and not a named party to this agreement.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant may not assign or transfer its obligations under this agreement to any other person.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant shall not sub-contract the performance of any of the Services without the Contractor's prior written consent. The Consultant shall be responsible for any services it sub-contracts to a third party as if it had performed those services itself.

children.name: text
children: Within five Business Days of receiving a written request from the Contractor, the Consultant shall execute and deliver to the Contractor a Warranty in favour of any Beneficiary identified by the Contractor in its written request.

children.name: text
children: If the Consultant fails to deliver any Warranty validly requested under clause 16.1 within five Business Days of the Contractor's written request, the Contractor shall not be obliged to make any further payment to the Consultant under this agreement until such Warranty is executed and delivered to the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant grants to the Contractor, with immediate effect, an irrevocable, non-exclusive, non-terminable, royalty-free licence to copy and make full use of any Material prepared by, or on behalf of, the Consultant for any purpose relating to the Project and the Property, including any of the Permitted Uses.

children.name: text
children: This licence allows the Contractor to use the Material in connection with any extension of the Project, but not to reproduce the designs contained in the Material in any such extension.

children.name: text
children: This licence carries the right to grant sub-licences and is transferable to third parties without the consent of the Consultant.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant shall not be liable for use of the Material for any purpose other than that for which it was prepared and/or provided.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant waives absolutely all Moral Rights the Consultant may have in the Material and/or the Project and where it is not the author shall procure a waiver from the author of any Moral Rights the author may have in respect of the Material and/or the Project.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may, at any time (whether before or after completion of the Services, or after termination of the Consultant's engagement under this agreement), request a copy or copies of (some or all of) the Material from the Consultant. On the Contractor's payment of the Consultant's reasonable charges for providing the copy (or copies), the Consultant shall provide the copy (or copies) to the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Each party undertakes that it shall not at any time disclose to any person any confidential information concerning the business, affairs, customers, clients or suppliers of the other party or of any member of the group of companies to which the other party belongs, except as permitted by clause 0.

children.name: text
children: Each party may disclose the other party's confidential information:

children: to its employees, officers, representatives, contractors, sub-contractors or advisers who need to know such information for the purposes of carrying out the party's obligations under this agreement.
